use paddock_env::cargo_layout;

fn layout() {
    let d = cargo_layout::profile_dir_of_exe(&std::env::current_exe().unwrap());
}

// the old guess: current_exe().parent().parent() and the deps/ folder
/// target/debug/deps/ in a doc comment
fn one_hop() {
    let here = std::env::current_exe().unwrap().parent().unwrap().to_path_buf();
    let n = "dependencies";
    let s = "a/deps_list/b";
}

fn statements() {
    let e = std::env::current_exe().unwrap();
    let up = e.parent().unwrap();
    let d = up.parent().unwrap();
}
